sql: WITH inspection_wide AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ((SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'running' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'running' AND attempts = 0 AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'retrying' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'running' AND attempts <> 0 AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'sleeping' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'suspended' AND wake_after IS NOT NULL AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'awaiting' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'suspended' AND wake_after IS NULL AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'completed' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'completed' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'cancelled' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'cancelled' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'failed' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'failed' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) > 2600 LIMIT 65)) AS wide_candidates LIMIT 65), wide_budget AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT count(*) > 64 OR coalesce(sum((octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id))),0) > 262144 AS exceeded FROM inspection_wide), inspection_page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM ((SELECT * FROM ((SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'running' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'running' AND attempts = 0 AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'retrying' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'running' AND attempts <> 0 AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'sleeping' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'suspended' AND wake_after IS NOT NULL AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'awaiting' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'suspended' AND wake_after IS NULL AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'completed' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'completed' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'cancelled' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'cancelled' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT workflow_id, workflow_name, generation, status, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, wake_after, leased_by, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM keiro.keiro_workflows WHERE 'failed' = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = 'failed' AND (octet_length(workflow_name) + octet_length(workflow_id)) <= 2600 ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2)) AS candidates ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inspection_wide) AS candidates WHERE NOT (SELECT exceeded FROM wide_budget) ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id LIMIT $2) SELECT now(), (SELECT exceeded FROM wide_budget), inspection_page.* FROM (VALUES (1)) AS clock(x) LEFT JOIN inspection_page ON true ORDER BY workflow_name, workflow_id
